entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a patient but ruthless ankylosaur-like dragon who usurped the Abzan and was defeated.

entities.name: Dromoka's Brood
entities.description: Armored dragons that emerged from Ugin's dragon tempests and breathe searing light.

entities.name: Clan Dromoka
entities.description: The former Abzan clan, renamed under Dromoka's rule and organized around dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit Dragon whose dragon tempests birthed the broods.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Saved Ugin, allowing the brood to thrive.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan who surrendered to Dromoka and ended necromancy.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Defector who challenged the dragonlord and was killed for disobedience.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Former planeswalker who uncovered the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and was convinced to use it.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual that called a massive dragonstorm and five spirit dragons, defeating the Dragonlords.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Event following Daghatar's surrender to Dromoka.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that caused heavy dragon casualties and weakened dragonlords' power.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: The elder dragons ruling Tarkir's clans.

events.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan over necromancy until Khan Daghatar is brought before her; he ends the kin-tree traditions and pacts with dragons.
events.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons

events.summary: Anafenza and other defectors challenge the dragonlord and are killed.
events.quote: Resistance to Dromoka grew from defectors like Anafenza who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion causes heavy dragon casualties; Dromoka's brood turn to ancestor spirits and rebel.
events.quote: many among Dromoka's brood turned to their ancestors

events.summary: Narset finds the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and is convinced by rebellion leaders to use it.
events.quote: she was convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir

events.summary: The ritual raises five spirit dragons, who battle the Dragonlords; the Dragonlords are defeated and seemingly swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: In the end, the Dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

relations.quote: Under the Elder Dragonlord Dromoka, the Abzan name was forgotten, and the group became known as clan Dromoka.

relations.note: usurped the Abzan clan from him
relations.quote: Dromoka usurped the Abzan clan from Daghatar
Resistance to Dromoka grew from defectors like Anafenza who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.
